title: Welcome
description: Unified attention dashboard — a desktop app that collects items that need your attention in one inbox, and keeps running in the background for syncs and notifications.

title: GitLab review requests
description: GitLab sync now also shows open merge requests where you are a reviewer, even without a matching label.

title: Sync fix
description: Fixed the inbox going empty and an "item already exists" error when a sync found nothing to change, e.g. after marking all items done.

title: Your Gerrit changes
description: Gerrit sync now also shows your own open changes. They stay muted until a label goes negative or both Verified and Code-Review are positive.

title: Your GitHub PRs and GitLab MRs
description: Your own open PRs and MRs are now flagged as outgoing and stay muted until they need you: changes requested, failing CI, conflicts, or ready to merge.

title: Open the app log
description: A bug icon next to Settings opens the app's log file, which now also records frontend console output in release builds.

title: Pull & Start works in the installed app
description: The custom Pull & Start command now runs in your login shell, so scripts and tools found in a terminal are also found when the app is launched from the Dock.

title: Service Bus tab
description: A new tab after Docker shows message counts for the queues, topics and subscriptions you pick in Settings. It uses your az login with the Reader role, so no Service Bus keys are needed.

title: Peek Service Bus messages
description: Each queue and subscription row has a peek button that shows its first 20 active or dead-letter messages (body, properties, dead-letter reason) without locking or consuming them. It needs the Azure Service Bus Data Receiver role on the namespace.

title: AI Review Prompt
description: The prompt for AI review action of gerrit items is now configurable in settings
